decisions.reason: The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already captures Transak card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and no-preexisting-wallet messaging completely.
Adding supported fiat payment methods and removing the need for preexisting crypto or a wallet does not change mint price or revenue allocation.
The source changes buyer payment access, not the identity of the NFT asset fulfilled by a mint.
Fiat on-ramp payment methods do not alter the required flat $10 royalty on secondary sales.
The source does not change the optional confirmation email or its referral-code content.
Supported fiat payment methods and wallet prerequisites do not change the mint number's role as the permanent referral code or its display locations.
The source changes fiat purchase accessibility but does not change which sale types fund prize pools or the funding duration.
Fiat payment support and wallet prerequisites do not change referral badge thresholds or award conditions.
The fiat on-ramp decision does not resume or otherwise change the deferred Discord community-server requirement.
The source distinguishes wallet needs for participation but does not change the manual one-click prize claim workflow.
Fiat payment methods and wallet prerequisites do not affect Chainlink VRF winner selection or ticket weighting.
Allowing fiat minting without preexisting crypto or a wallet does not change the existing no-auth rule for public referral statistics.
